lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of circular high-luminance blobs organized in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial slits, with inter-centroid spacing increasing in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal planes of blobs, creating a coordinate-like anchoring system where blobs are centered within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible; the primary lateral ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the superior edge and a distinct shadow-cast gradient on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs located primarily at the base and leading edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; a dark linear marking is present on the lower posterior flank consistent with an external parasite attachment site.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density cluster of minute, irregular high-luminance spots localized on the cephalic region anterior to the first branchial slit.
